import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 5007;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long capacity, weight, flow;

        Edge(int s, int d, long cap, long w) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            capacity = cap;
            weight = w;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edge_list = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] dist = new long[MAX_NODES];
    static long[] pot = new long[MAX_NODES];
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] prev_edge = new int[MAX_NODES];

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c_val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d_val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] counts = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int ai = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            counts[--ai]++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            add_edge(5000, i, counts[i], 0);
        }

        for (int it = 0; it < m; it++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 99; i++) {
                long edge_cost = d_val;
                for (int j = 0; j < 50; j++) {
                    add_edge(u + i * 50, v + (i + 1) * 50, 1, edge_cost);
                    add_edge(v + i * 50, u + (i + 1) * 50, 1, edge_cost);
                    edge_cost += 2L * d_val;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            add_edge(0 + i * 50, 5001, Long.MAX_VALUE, (long) c_val * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 99; j++) {
                add_edge(i + j * 50, i + (j + 1) * 50, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }

        long[] result = min_cost_max_flow(5000, 5001);
        assert result[1] == k;
        System.out.println(result[0]);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap, long wgt) {
        adj[u].add(edge_list.size());
        edge_list.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, wgt));
        adj[v].add(edge_list.size());
        edge_list.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, -wgt));
    }

    static void bellman_ford(int source, int nodes) {
        Arrays.fill(pot, INF);
        pot[source] = 0;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < nodes; iter++) {
            for (int idx = 0; idx < edge_list.size(); idx++) {
                Edge e = edge_list.get(idx);
                if (e.capacity == e.flow) continue;
                if (pot[e.src] == INF) continue;
                if (pot[e.src] + e.weight < pot[e.dst]) {
                    pot[e.dst] = pot[e.src] + e.weight;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void dijkstra(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        dist[source] = 0;
        TreeSet<int[]> pq = new TreeSet<>((a, b) -> {
            if (a[0] != b[0]) return Long.compare(a[0], b[0]);
            return Integer.compare(a[1], b[1]);
        });
        pq.add(new int[]{0, source});
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] entry = pq.first();
            pq.remove(entry);
            long d_val = entry[0];
            int v = entry[1];
            for (int eid : adj[v]) {
                Edge e = edge_list.get(eid);
                if (e.capacity == e.flow) continue;
                int w = e.dst;
                long reduced_cost = e.weight + pot[v] - pot[w];
                if (dist[v] + reduced_cost < dist[w]) {
                    if (dist[w] != INF) {
                        pq.remove(new int[]{(int) dist[w], w});
                    }
                    dist[w] = dist[v] + reduced_cost;
                    prev_edge[w] = eid;
                    pq.add(new int[]{(int) dist[w], w});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] min_cost_max_flow(int src, int dst) {
        bellman_ford(src, 50);
        dijkstra(src);
        long total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
        while (dist[dst] != INF) {
            long bottleneck = INF;
            long sum_cost = 0;
            for (int cur = dst; cur != src; ) {
                int eid = prev_edge[cur];
                bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, edge_list.get(eid).capacity - edge_list.get(eid).flow);
                sum_cost += edge_list.get(eid).weight;
                cur = edge_list.get(eid).src;
            }
            total_flow += bottleneck;
            total_cost += bottleneck * sum_cost;
            for (int cur = dst; cur != src; ) {
                int eid = prev_edge[cur];
                edge_list.get(eid).flow += bottleneck;
                edge_list.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= bottleneck;
                cur = edge_list.get(eid).src;
            }
            dijkstra(src);
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
                pot[i] = dist[i];
            }
        }
        return new long[]{total_cost, total_flow};
    }
}
